jobs.description:

The role emphasizes visible deterrence, teamwork, and a people-first culture. Full-time position with a shift schedule and opportunities for growth within a nationwide security leader.

jobs.title: Unarmed Security , Benefits & Growth
jobs.description:
A leading security company in Chicago is seeking an Unarmed Security Officer to provide customized security solutions. The role involves monitoring safety equipment, responding to alarms, and interacting with clients. Candidates must hold a current guard card, be 21 years or older, and pass a drug test.

A high school diploma is required, and a college degree is preferred. This position offers competitive pay and comprehensive training, making it a great opportunity for those committed to a career in security.

jobs.title: Part-Time Unarmed Security Guard — Paid Uniforms & Benefits
jobs.description:
Stark Security Inc. is seeking a part-time Unarmed Security Guard in Chicago, Illinois. The role involves patrolling properties, preventing crime, and providing excellent customer service. The position requires a high school education, a valid driver's license, and the ability to obtain a PERC license within 30 days of employment.

Join a dedicated team that values professionalism and community service, with a pay rate between $18 and $19 per hour. Comprehensive training and support are offered to ensure success for all security personnel.

jobs.title: Mobile Security Officer (Unarmed) – Chicago Shifts
jobs.description: KATES DETECTIVE & SECURITY AGENCY INC seeks a Mobile Unarmed Security Officer in Chicago, Illinois. The role involves patrolling assigned locations, maintaining safety, and providing customer service. Candidates must have a valid Illinois PERC Card, a clean driving record, and pass background checks. Experience in security and strong communication skills are preferred. The compensation ranges from $16.60 to $17.00 per hour with flexible scheduling, including nights and weekends.
